assessments.reasoning: The six verified publisher ranges define both forms, identify the shared executable-distribution trigger and cover both limbs of section 3.2. Reading them together supports the claimed permission with its source-rights proviso and continuing access duty.

limitations: This permission concerns the Executable Form. Whether particular terms attempt to limit or alter source rights depends on their wording and reach.
reasoning: Section 3.2(b) allows the distributor to use MPL terms for the executable or to sublicense it on different terms. The executable license must preserve recipients’ MPL rights in the source. Section 3.2(a) continues to apply under either choice.
